senses.gloss: ईदृ॑क्ष mf(ई)n. (fr. इद्, neut. of pronom. base 3. इ, and दृक्ष, √ दृश्, dropping one द् and lengthening the preceding इ; cf. तदृक्ष from तद्, &c.), of this aspect, of such a kind, endowed with such qualities, such-like, VS.; Kathās. &c.
ई-दृ॑श् क्, mfn. (Ved. ङ्, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 83) endowed with such qualities, such, VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; Śak.; Pañcat. &c.
ई-दृ॑श् (क्), n. such a condition, such occasion, RV.; AV.
ईदृग्-अवस्थ mfn. being in such a situation, Vṛṣabhān.

ईदृ॑श, mf(ई)n. or ईदृशक, mf(इका)n. endowed with such qualities, such, ŚBr.; ChUp.; Mn.; R.; Bhag. : Śak. &c.;
 [with the final syllables दृश् and दृश of these words cf. the Gk. λικ in ὁμῆλιξ, λικο in τηλίκο-ς &c.; Goth. leika in hvêleiks, ‘which one’, svaleik-s, ‘such’; Mod. Germ. welcher, solcher; Slav. liko nom. lik, e.g. tolik, ‘such’; Lat. li in tâlis, quâlis.]

ईदृ॑श, mf(ई)n. or ईदृशक, mf(इका)n. endowed with such qualities, such, ŚBr.; ChUp.; Mn.; R.; Bhag. : Śak. &c.;
 [with the final syllables दृश् and दृश of these words cf. the Gk. λικ in ὁμῆλιξ, λικο in τηλίκο-ς &c.; Goth. leika in hvêleiks, ‘which one’, svaleik-s, ‘such’; Mod. Germ. welcher, solcher; Slav. liko nom. lik, e.g. tolik, ‘such’; Lat. li in tâlis, quâlis.]
ईदृश-भूत mfn. being such a one, Naiṣ.
